name: Secure My WP Site – Login
author: Secure My WP Site

sections.description:
Secure My WP Site – Login provides a complete user management system for WordPress sites with enhanced security features and customizable forms.

Key Features:

  • Secure login system with email-based authentication
  • User registration with optional email verification
  • Profile management for users
  • Password reset functionality
  • Account deletion capability (can be disabled by admin)
  • Custom redirect after login
  • Built-in security measures (nonce verification, input sanitization)
  • Responsive form design that works with any theme
  • Extensible with add-ons for additional functionality

The plugin automatically creates 9 pages with corresponding shortcodes:

  1. Login Page – [smwps_login_form]
  2. Registration Page – [smwps_register_form]
  3. Profile Page – [smwps_profile_form]
  4. Lost Password Page – [smwps_lost_password_form]
  5. Reset Password Page – [smwps_reset_password_form]
  6. Email Confirmation Page – [smwps_confirm_email_form]
  7. Delete Account Page – [smwps_delete_account_form]
  8. Delete Account Success Page – [smwps_delete_account_successful]
  9. Logout Success Page – [smwps_successful_logout]

Additional Notes

For documentation on implementation and customization, visit our website
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/secure-my-wp-site-login directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->Secure My WP Site->Login screen to configure the plugin
  4. Place shortcodes in your pages or use the automatically created pages
sections.faq:
Can I customize the redirect URL after login?

Yes, you can set a custom redirect URL in the plugin settings.

Can I disable account deletion?

Yes, administrators can disable the account deletion feature in the plugin settings.

Can I customize the form styles?

Yes, the forms use standard CSS classes and can be styled using your theme’s stylesheet.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fixed: Headers already sent warning in profile and reset password pages
  • Fixed: Account deletion functionality in non-admin context
  • Fixed: Duplicate password reset confirmation emails
  • Fixed: Added proper nonce verification for password reset links
  • Improved: Error handling for invalid password reset links

1.1.0

  • Improved compatibility with page builders. Template override is no longer needed.

1.0.0

  • Initial release
